proposal.expected_benefit: This will prevent ambiguities in control implementation and ensure that the system enforces audit and compliance requirements even when the audit anchor is failed, thereby reducing the risk of bypassing security checks.
proposal.problem: The defense does not clearly address how the failed audit anchor was bypassed or how the system allowed the attack to proceed despite the failed audit anchor.
proposal.proposed_change: Add a specific strategy to explicitly clarify how audit and compliance enforcement are resolved in the event of a failed audit anchor, ensuring that the system does not allow any unauthorized actions despite the failure.
proposal.title: Enhance Clarification of Audit and Compliance Enforcement
verification_tests: Verify that the strategy explicitly addresses how audit and compliance enforcement are resolved in the case of a failed audit anchor.
Ensure that the strategy prevents unauthorized actions despite the failure of the audit anchor.
